svg.title: Real Collatz path-image atlas for n=27
svg.desc: Generated from the actual Collatz path-image encoders: recurrence plot, Gramian Angular Field, Markov Transition Field, parity raster, and residue raster.
svg.text: n=27, total steps=111, peak=9232, peak log2=13.172. Every pixel is generated from the computed trajectory.
Generated by build/collatz_path_image_atlas using the same C++ encoder functions as collatz_path_image; this is data representation, not a proof.
